title: Getting started with Local Services Ads - United States - Local Services Help

facts.fact: Local Services Ads charge advertisers only for leads related to their business and the services they offer.
facts.quote: Pay only for leads related to your business and the services you offer.

facts.fact: Booking leads are not available for health care verticals.
facts.quote: Booking leads aren't available for health care verticals.

facts.fact: The Google Verified badge is currently unavailable for verticals in the auto, beauty, and dining categories.
facts.quote: The Google Verified badge is currently unavailable for verticals in the auto, beauty, and dining categories.

facts.fact: Pre-badge ads are not available for garage door services, health care verticals, and locksmiths.
facts.quote: Pre-badge ads aren't available for garage door services, health care verticals, and locksmiths.

facts.fact: To go live with pre-badge ads, a provider must complete billing setup and set a budget, among other requirements.
facts.quote: Complete billing setup and set your budget

facts.fact: To go live with pre-badge ads, a provider must have reviews, subject to category requirements.
For professional verticals, the pre-badge requirement for business registration applies in the UK.
Pre-badge listings are placed below providers who have completed all onboarding requirements and obtained the Google Badge in consumer search results.
facts.quote: Google will place the listing below providers who’ve completed all onboarding requirements and obtained the Google Badge.

facts.fact: Google states that a provider's ad ranking may be affected if it regularly fails to answer calls or respond to messages.
facts.quote: If you regularly fail to answer calls or respond to messages, your ad ranking may be affected.

facts.fact: Google states that Local Services Ads are currently available only for certain service categories.
facts.quote: At this time, Local Services Ads are available only for certain service categories.

facts.fact: Google states that the Google Verified badge signals to consumers that a business has passed Google's proprietary screening process.
facts.quote: signaling to consumers that your business has passed Google’s proprietary screening process.

facts.fact: Google's Local Services Ads category list marks Architect as available only in California and Florida.
Google's Local Services Ads category list marks Drain expert, Home insulation, Insurance agency, Interior designer, Piercing studio, and Tattoo studio as available only in California and Florida.
Google states that tracking bookings and lead credits, and asking for reviews, are features available only in the US and Canada.
facts.quote: Track your bookings (US and Canada only)

facts.fact: Google states that advertisers can pause their Local Services Ad when too busy to accept new leads.
facts.quote: Pause your ad if you’re too busy to accept new leads

facts.fact: Google states that for advertisers using a partner affiliate, the affiliate provides the advertiser's profile information to Google directly.
facts.quote: If you are advertising through a partner affiliate, your profile information is provided to us by the partner affiliate directly.
